description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's fourth ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Thopter, creating a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token, a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token, and a Food token.
Activate Urza's first ability three times by tapping the Thopter, Construct and Food, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
